title: Formatting Primitive-Envy (Month to String)
pattern: Formatting or converting logic for a domain concept is held in a generic utility class, taking primitive indicators as input.
why_bad: Clients must explicitly pass raw integers around, losing type safety, and the formatting rules are disconnected from the data they represent.
detection: A matching function mapping a primitive code to its string representation outside of any domain type representing that code.
counterexample: A centralized translation service that requires external context or locale configuration.
